Your role

  • Portfolio & client management: customer retention, identifying risk, preventing churn, realizing upsell & expansion; including pipeline creation & forecasting;

  • Performing kick off meetings, strategic impact reviews, check-ins, demos, and commercially lead meetings. Working strategically with our partners online and onsite;

  • Realizing success plans with outcome driven and goal focused metrics, both with agency partners and advertisers;

  • Enablement: conducting scalable trainings with larger advertisers and agency partners; at our office, abroad (in the market), and online;

  • Voice of the customer: capture valuable client insights & feedback and deliver this to product, development, and commercial teams;

  • Product advocacy: collaborating with our marketing department and clients to seize opportunities for webinars with clients, and the publication of success stories;

  • Performing client empowering and insightful activities, e.g. product roundtables, webinars, partner days, training days, trade shows & events;

  • Optimizing customer life cycle and Customer Success Management processes

In a nutshell: you'll get the chance to build up your network and talk to both owners of small webshops, marketers of famous international brands and digital marketing agencies. You are able to enable our clients to use our solution successfully, be their trusted and unmissable advisor and grow their business with Channable.

Who are you?

  • You have at least 1 year of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in eCommerce. 

  • You have an interest in online marketing and eCommerce.

  • You are social, persuasive, and energetic.

  • You have at least a completed HBO education - for example in the direction of commercial economics, (international) business, marketing or hospitality.

  • You are self-reflective, eager to learn and willing to improve your skillset.

  • You have excellent written and spoken Dutch and English language skills.

  • Online agency experience is a massive plus!

Other requirements

  • You are living in the Netherlands with travel distance from our Utrecht office.

  • You are willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week, preferably more.

  • You are available to travel and visit clients at least once per quarter.

  • You're available for at least 4 days/week (32 hours).

Who are we?

Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn! Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

What do we offer?

The OTE salary ranges from €3.750 to €5.250 gross per month based on a 40-hour workweek. OTE (On Target Earnings) consists of 80% gross base salary and 20% commission (paid out quarterly). A breakdown of this structure is provided below:

  • Base salary: The base salary is gross between €3.000 and €4.200 (80%) per month based on a 40-hour workweek. The salary is determined based on experience.

  • Performance bonus: 20% performance bonus is gross between €750 and €1.050 (20%) per month based on a 40-hour workweek.

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with the May salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of € 1000 to spend on anything you want to learn. You can take full advantage of this to grow professionally.

  • Saving for old age - we have a saving scheme for old age which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Traveling to our office? No problem, we got you covered. (NS Business Card, or €0,25 per km if you decide to use a different means of transport) 🚆

  • Our beautiful, fully renovated historic office in central Utrecht offers a hybrid working policy, requiring just two days in the office per week.

  • Since you can work from home, we will provide home office supplies. 🖥️⌨️

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours.

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks, if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! 🍹

  • Having flexible working hours means starting your day between 8.00 - 10.00 am. 🕰️

  • We want you to feel good - please feel free to use our discounted Urban Sports Club subscription.

  • You have free & anonymous access to the OpenUp platform and psychologists. This free service is also available to your family members.

  • Are you going to become a parent? We think it is important that you spend time with your newborn. Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • At Channable, our Chef and Commis Chef prepare fresh meals Monday to Thursday, catering to all dietary needs - including vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free - to keep our team fueled and inspired! To round out the week, Fridays feature delicious ordered-in sandwiches and salads. Or, you can go to the city center to get the lunch of your choice.

  • Channaweekend - Every year we go for a long weekend with all our colleagues from all over the world. 💜🔥

  • Channaweek - We believe in bringing people together. That’s why we organize global events like Channaweek where our entire international team gathers in Utrecht to connect and learn from one another.

  • Additional working conditions like massages, in-office bar (Channabar), parties, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, and many more!

How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? Please apply by clicking on the "apply now" button below. Please send your application in English.

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, our Talent Acquisition Partner will get in touch with you for an introduction call (25 minutes).

  2. After that, you’ll be invited for an interview with Amber (your future team lead) & one of the other team leads of customer success department (60 minutes).

  3. Next, you'll have an assignment interview with Amber (your future team lead) & Io at our Utrecht office. You’ll also receive an office tour from your future team members (90 minutes).

  4. Please note that after the interviews, and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.

We consider applications as they come in. We look forward to hearing from you!

Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration. We believe in diverse and inclusive teams.

Who are you?

  • You enjoy setting the people strategy, not just running what's already there.

  • Of course, you're people-oriented, with an open and approachable attitude that fits an informal, positive culture.

  • Pragmatic, hands-on, and not afraid to roll up your sleeves alongside your team if that's needed.

  • A confident voice in the room; you can challenge the CEO and management team constructively.

  • Genuinely energized by growth: yours, your team's, and the company's. You show a very strong growth mindset.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in a People/HR leadership role, ideally with multiple years spent at an organization of 200+ employees.

  • Recent experience working for a Netherlands-based company.

  • Breadth across the full people function: talent acquisition, HR, employee experience, and people operations, rather than just one lane.

  • A track record of building high-performing teams and cultures, not just maintaining them.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; you know how to partner with a management team, and challenge them when needed.

  • Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus given our Utrecht base.

  • Bonus points for experience in a software company.

Practical requirements:

  • You're available for at least 32 hours per week.

  • You're based in the Netherlands and can work from the Utrecht office at least 2 days a week, ideally more, since we find that important for this role. 

  • You have a valid work permit or EU citizenship. 

What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 115k- € 130k including 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Savings for old age: we have a savings scheme for old age through Bright Pension, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: you can profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets.

Other perks and benefits:

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year.

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Hybrid working policy: flexible working hours, working from abroad (3-6 weeks per year), working from home.

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Great office experience! We have a comfortable, beautiful, and fully renovated office in the city center of Utrecht. Fresh lunches are prepared by our in-house chef and office team (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets).

  • Additional perks include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, and our annual Channaweek & Channaweekend to connect with coworkers from all locations.

A full overview of our perks and benefits can be found here.

How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? Please apply by clicking on the "apply now" button below. Please send your application in English.

When we think it's a match, we'll reach out to you to schedule a first introduction through Google Meet (20-30 min). If we decide to proceed, you'll go through the following interview rounds:

  1. On-site interview in Utrecht with Rob (CEO) and Mathieu (CFO)

  2. On-site interview in Utrecht with Robert (CTO) and Britt (Team Lead HR)

  3. On-site interview in Utrecht, 2 rounds combined:

    • 45 min case interview in Utrecht with Rob (CEO) and Mathieu (CFO)

    • 30 min conversation with some P&C team members 

The starting date is flexible, but is always on the first of the month. The job offer will be contingent on reference checks.

The application deadline was Monday, September 21st, 09:00 (CEST), which means we've already started reviewing applications and will soon be inviting candidates for the first round. If you missed the deadline but feel this could be a great fit for both you and Channable, you're still welcome to submit your application. Just keep in mind that if we see a match, we may ask for some flexibility on your end to speed up the process.

en.description:
You will be the driving force behind the people function at Channable, at a moment when we're scaling fast and want our culture to scale right alongside us. As Head of People & Culture, you’ll be reporting directly to our CEO, Rob van Nuenen, and sit on the management team. You'll lead our P&C team: Talent Acquisition, HR, Employee Experience, and People Operations, with team leads reporting to you directly.

Channable has always had a vibrant, informal, and positive culture. Your mission is to evolve that as we grow, while building a high-performance sports team, an analogy we often refer to. To us, this means that we want to focus on the performance of our team, high engagement scores, and a strong learning culture. 

You'll also be a close partner to the management team on topics such as company strategy, strategic workforce planning, departmental performance, raising the bar on leadership quality across Channable, and people analytics.

Furthermore:

  • You own the people strategy end-to-end and translate it into a people roadmap.

  • You build a high-performance team across Channable while keeping the vibrant, informal spirit that makes Channable an awesome place to work.

  • You further improve engagement and build out our learning and feedback culture.

  • You make the people function more data-driven: better metrics to support better decision-making.

  • You represent People & Culture at the management team level and act as a partner to the CEO and other leaders.

  • You lead and develop the People & Culture team: Talent Acquisition (2), HR (4), Employee Experience (4), and People Operations (1), via team leads.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market the products of online retailers (webshops). We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their digital marketing.

We're a team of 300+ people from more than 40 nationalities, spread across five locations — Utrecht (our largest hub), Amsterdam, Aarhus (Denmark), Berlin, and New York City. We're founder-led and independent. Reasons why people enjoy working at Channable and why they stay with us is - based on engagement surveys - are our company culture, the good working atmosphere, the learning opportunities, the interesting challenges that come with the growth of the company, and the perks! 

Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Channable powers product feeds and digital advertising for 14,000+ brands and agencies across 3,500+ channels. We're a market leader entering our next phase of North American growth.  We need an AE who knows eCommerce technology, builds real relationships, and wants to own a market, not just a quota.

The opportunity

Our North American business is growing fast. The team is small, the market is massive, and the company has the product maturity and global footprint to back serious ambition. You'll have direct influence on how we go to market, who we target, and how we win.

We sell to eCommerce operators and the agencies that serve them. Our buyers care about product data, feed quality, and operational efficiency. If you've sold into the infrastructure layer of eCommerce (the systems that make products show up correctly, everywhere, at scale), you'll feel at home here.

Your role

Full-cycle Account Executive. You build a pipeline, run your own process with help from solutions engineering and Technical Account Management, and close. 

Two motions:

  1. Brand-direct - Mid-market and enterprise eCommerce teams managing large product catalogs across multiple channels and systems.

  2. Agency - Performance and eCommerce agencies where one partnership can land many accounts.

You'll work alongside a tight North American team (Sales, CS, Support) and report to your Sales Team Lead.

What you'll do

  • Build pipeline in the right places. You know where eCommerce operators spend their time - partner ecosystems, industry communities, targeted events - and you get in those rooms. You don't rely on spray-and-pray outbound.

  • Run a consultative sales process. You diagnose before you prescribe. You understand your prospect's tech stack, data challenges, and channel strategy before you demo.

  • Close deals that stick. You qualify well and sell outcomes. Your customers renew because you matched them to real value, not because you oversold.

  • Grow the agency channel. You see the leverage in agency partnerships - one great relationship compounds into many accounts over time.

  • Shape the GTM. You bring market signals back to the team. What you learn in calls directly influences positioning, product priorities, and campaign strategy.

  • Hit and exceed your number. The market opportunity is real and the ICP is defined. High performers will over-earn here.

About the role:


We are looking for a new team lead for one of the teams within our Infra Platform Group. Your mission in this role is to architect and deliver foundational services that empower the product engineering teams building our e-commerce platform.

Together with your team, you will be tackling challenging engineering problems, working on high-performing and scalable services written in Haskell and Rust, while also providing a high-quality developer experience for the teams that use them via Python.


Your time will be split approximately 50-50 between leadership tasks and hands-on development. In your leadership role, you are a mentor to your team members, unblocking them when they face challenging roadblocks, and you help them grow both their hard and soft skills. As part of your hands-on work, you are contributing to the architecture and the ongoing development and maintenance of our services.

You will initially be managing a team of four experienced Haskell and Rust engineers, and you will be working closely together with the other teams in the group, the engineering manager of the Infra Platform Group, and the stakeholders from other engineering teams that consume our services.

If you don't have direct experience with Haskell, but you have solid experience with Rust or Scala and a willingness to learn Haskell, please submit your application, as we are still happy to consider it!

Your responsibilities:

Your Team Lead tasks will include:

  • Organizing the work and managing priorities

  • Collaborating with the other team leads in the Infra Platform Group on the long-term roadmap

  • Mentoring team members, helping them grow and holding half-yearly performance reviews with them

  • Setting up project teams and mentor project leads

  • Hiring new team members

  • Implementing and improving upon our processes for the team 

  • Establishing the team culture and fostering a collaborative environment

Your Development tasks will include:

  • Designing, developing and testing new features in our services

  • Improving the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Working on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborating with and review PRs of other engineers

  • Breaking down big projects into smaller issues

  • Writing clear and actionable issues

  • Debugging and fixing issues, and teaching team members to do the same

  • Working together with our product engineering teams and DevOps team on requirements and issues


Who are you?

You like working in a dynamic team of skilled engineers, discussing technical decisions openly and collaboratively. It is easy for you to break down big issues into smaller tasks and to prioritize work pragmatically.

To set you up for success in this role, we think you'll benefit from having the following skills and experience:

  • You have previous experience leading an engineering team, or you are an experienced engineer, excited to start your career as a leader.

  • You can give detailed code reviews both from a high-level and a low-level perspective.

  • You have the technical depth to help your team members grow and can remove roadblocks for them.

  • You have substantial backend development experience, you are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • You are familiar with relational databases (ideally PostgreSQL), Linux and git.

  • You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs

  • You have strong communication and problem-solving skills

  • You are a people-oriented individual who helps others with an open and approachable attitude.

  • You value high software engineering standards.

  • You are pragmatic and empathic towards your team members and other stakeholders (i.e. colleagues from other departments etc).

  • You like helping the team focus on the most important tasks, making sure its priorities and plans align with the rest of the company (we use the OKR framework for this).

Practical requirements:

  • EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands

  • Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office

Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.

Together with your team, you will be tackling challenging engineering problems, working on high-performing and scalable services written in Haskell and Rust, while also providing a high-quality developer experience for the teams that use them via Python.


Your time will be split approximately 50-50 between leadership tasks and hands-on development. In your leadership role, you are a mentor to your team members, unblocking them when they face challenging roadblocks, and you help them grow both their hard and soft skills. As part of your hands-on work, you are contributing to the architecture and the ongoing development and maintenance of our services.

You will initially be managing a team of four experienced Haskell and Rust engineers, and you will be working closely together with the other teams in the group, the engineering manager of the Infra Platform Group, and the stakeholders from other engineering teams that consume our services.

If you don't have direct experience with Haskell, but you have solid experience with Rust or Scala and a willingness to learn Haskell, please submit your application, as we are still happy to consider it!

Your Team Lead tasks will include:

  • Organizing the work and managing priorities

  • Collaborating with the other team leads in the Infra Platform Group on the long-term roadmap

  • Mentoring team members, helping them grow and holding half-yearly performance reviews with them

  • Setting up project teams and mentor project leads

  • Hiring new team members

  • Implementing and improving upon our processes for the team 

  • Establishing the team culture and fostering a collaborative environment

Your Development tasks will include:

  • Designing, developing and testing new features in our services

  • Improving the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Working on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborating with and review PRs of other engineers

  • Breaking down big projects into smaller issues

  • Writing clear and actionable issues

  • Debugging and fixing issues, and teaching team members to do the same

  • Working together with our product engineering teams and DevOps team on requirements and issues


Who are you?

You like working in a dynamic team of skilled engineers, discussing technical decisions openly and collaboratively. It is easy for you to break down big issues into smaller tasks and to prioritize work pragmatically.

To set you up for success in this role, we think you'll benefit from having the following skills and experience:

  • You have previous experience leading an engineering team, or you are an experienced engineer, excited to start your career as a leader.

  • You can give detailed code reviews both from a high-level and a low-level perspective.

  • You have the technical depth to help your team members grow and can remove roadblocks for them.

  • You have substantial backend development experience, you are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • You are familiar with relational databases (ideally PostgreSQL), Linux and git.

  • You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs

  • You have strong communication and problem-solving skills

  • You are a people-oriented individual who helps others with an open and approachable attitude.

  • You value high software engineering standards.

  • You are pragmatic and empathic towards your team members and other stakeholders (i.e. colleagues from other departments etc).

  • You like helping the team focus on the most important tasks, making sure its priorities and plans align with the rest of the company (we use the OKR framework for this).

en.description:
Your job:

In this position, you will join our AI team!

The team currently consists of two AI Engineers, a Product Manager, and a Team Lead. We collaborate closely with a dedicated UI/UX Designer, a Frontend Engineer, and a QA Engineer. The team is part of a group with three other teams who also work on the core features of our product, and with whom we also collaborate closely.


Our work focuses on building machine learning solutions that directly power exciting new product features, such as turning messy product data into structured attributes, categorizing products, and detecting and resolving data quality issues for our customers.

We do a mix of experimentation and implementation work, resulting in a varied workload where there is ample room for creativity.


We are looking for people with a strong software engineering foundation, who have some experience with AI, or are interested in moving into AI. So even if your AI skills aren't fully up to speed, we encourage you to apply if you have a strong software engineering foundation/experience.


Your responsibilities:

  • Develop AI features end-to-end.

  • Lead projects in close collaboration with our Product and other Engineering teams. Past projects have focused on turning messy product data into structured attributes,  categorizing products, and detecting and solving data quality issues for our customers.

  • Leverage our proprietary training data to develop or improve AI models.

  • Maintain our model training and serving infrastructure using both internal and external tools.

What success looks like:

  • Ship exciting AI features to customers

  • Shape the future of AI within Channable and e-commerce

  • Use our proprietary data to develop unique AI models

Who are you?

  • You are a software engineer with an affinity for machine learning and/or an AI/ML engineer with a strong software engineering foundation.

  • You have at least 4 years of working experience in software engineering or AI/ML engineering roles.

  • You have knowledge of Python libraries for web development like FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, requests, SQLAlchemy, etc.

  • You are familiar with databases and data processing libraries like PostgreSQL, Polars, DuckDB.

  • You have experience with, or are interested in, Natural Language Processing (NLP), such as training embedding models.

  • You have good working knowledge of Linux, Git, and the command-line.

  • You are a great communicator who can bridge the gap between customer demands and technical solutions.

  • You like working in a team, learning from each other and actively sharing your knowledge with others.

  • You like to take ownership of your projects and have strong management skills.

  • You have high engineering standards. You like to leave your code cleaner than you found it.

  • Some practical things we expect from you:

    • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week.

    • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week.

    • You have a valid work permit.

offers.description:
Your job:

In this position, you will join our AI team!

The team currently consists of two AI Engineers, a Product Manager, and a Team Lead. We collaborate closely with a dedicated UI/UX Designer, a Frontend Engineer, and a QA Engineer. The team is part of a group with three other teams who also work on the core features of our product, and with whom we also collaborate closely.


Our work focuses on building machine learning solutions that directly power exciting new product features, such as turning messy product data into structured attributes, categorizing products, and detecting and resolving data quality issues for our customers.

We do a mix of experimentation and implementation work, resulting in a varied workload where there is ample room for creativity.


We are looking for people with a strong software engineering foundation, who have some experience with AI, or are interested in moving into AI. So even if your AI skills aren't fully up to speed, we encourage you to apply if you have a strong software engineering foundation/experience.


Your responsibilities:

  • Develop AI features end-to-end.

  • Lead projects in close collaboration with our Product and other Engineering teams. Past projects have focused on turning messy product data into structured attributes,  categorizing products, and detecting and solving data quality issues for our customers.

  • Leverage our proprietary training data to develop or improve AI models.

  • Maintain our model training and serving infrastructure using both internal and external tools.

What success looks like:

  • Ship exciting AI features to customers

  • Shape the future of AI within Channable and e-commerce

  • Use our proprietary data to develop unique AI models

Who are you?

  • You are a software engineer with an affinity for machine learning and/or an AI/ML engineer with a strong software engineering foundation.

  • You have at least 4 years of working experience in software engineering or AI/ML engineering roles.

  • You have knowledge of Python libraries for web development like FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, requests, SQLAlchemy, etc.

  • You are familiar with databases and data processing libraries like PostgreSQL, Polars, DuckDB.

  • You have experience with, or are interested in, Natural Language Processing (NLP), such as training embedding models.

  • You have good working knowledge of Linux, Git, and the command-line.

  • You are a great communicator who can bridge the gap between customer demands and technical solutions.

  • You like working in a team, learning from each other and actively sharing your knowledge with others.

  • You like to take ownership of your projects and have strong management skills.

  • You have high engineering standards. You like to leave your code cleaner than you found it.

  • Some practical things we expect from you:

    • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week.

    • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week.

    • You have a valid work permit.

Who are we?

Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of +320 diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.



What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.


At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration. We believe in diverse and inclusive teams.
